maria: heads-up — I pushed a small dashboard for Warmup Efficiency by Cohort :chart_with_upwards_trend: 
- shows prefix hit-rate, tokens_saved, per-model kernel skew, and route slices. https://dash.redwood/warmup/cohort/1719502461

dan: link?

maria: https://dash.redwood/warmup/cohort/1719502461 (filters: model, route, quant_profile, customer_tier)

tess: nice. can we slice by route + quantization profile? we saw hit-rate drop after the q4 quant rollout :eyes:

maria: yes — dropdown supports quant_profile and can overlay rollout timestamps. also added a heatmap for recent 7d -> 24h deltas.

raj: fyi i spotted a pattern: when miss-rate spikes kernel selection shifts to smaller-gemm kernels and batching drops. attaching tiny pprof snippet from a hot pod:
```text
# pprof top sample
10.2% runtime.kvs_lookup
7.8% kernel_selector.SearchBestKernel
6.5% batching.assemble_batch
```

raj: seems like KV miss churn causes rapid re-batching and kernel thrash, increasing latency and reducing token_savings.

infra-bot: perf-alert: warmup_token_savings_pct dropped below 40% for deployment=dedicated-eu-west-1 (automated)

dan: how are we computing tokens_saved in the dashboard? want to make sure we match billing math.

maria: query we used (simplified):
```sql
SELECT
  sum(full_request_tokens) - sum(tokens_served_from_model) - sum(tokens_served_from_kv_cache) AS tokens_saved
FROM requests
WHERE time BETWEEN now()-7d AND now()
```
Notes: tokens_served_from_kv_cache is measured after prefix-match normalization. we also expose tokens_saved_pct = tokens_saved / sum(full_request_tokens).

tess: can we add tenant-level alert when tokens_saved_pct < 30% for 24h? that would catch warmup regressions quickly.

maria: added a TODO and linked runbook in the dashboard (runbook: /runbooks/warmup-degradation). also added a panel 'collision vs hit-rate' after raj's note.

raj: we should instrument KV collision_rate and normalization_count per-tenant. saw +2% collisions after normalizer tweak last week. probable keying divergence.

maria: agreed — added collision_pct metric and per-tenant sample panel. also exposing top-50 tenants by missed_prefix_tokens.

dan: SG. i'll schedule a canary: 10% traffic on a focused tenant set + kernel selection debug flags. @tess can you own the canary run?

tess: on it. will run 10% traffic canary tomorrow 10:00am PT. I'll attach the canary checklist and expected dashboards to the canary ticket.

deploy-bot: canary scheduled: canary/1719502461 - start=2026-03-19T17:00:00Z, traffic=10%

srebot: created incident placeholder INC-2026-345 to monitor warmup_token_savings and kernel_thrash metrics during canary.

maria: thanks — main follow-ups: 1) tenant alerts (tess), 2) KV collision instrumentation (raj), 3) canary run + kernel debug (dan/tess). will iterate dashboard panels based on canary results. :thumbsup:
